INSERT INTO stock_supply_demand_daily ( stock_code, trade_date, close_price, individual_net_buy_qty, foreign_net_buy_qty, institution_net_buy_qty, individual_net_buy_amount, foreign_net_buy_amount, institution_net_buy_amount ) VALUES
( #{item.stockCode}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.closePrice}, #{item.individualNetBuyQty}, #{item.foreignNetBuyQty}, #{item.institutionNetBuyQty}, #{item.individualNetBuyAmount}, #{item.foreignNetBuyAmount}, #{item.institutionNetBuyAmount} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE close_price = VALUES(close_price), individual_net_buy_qty = VALUES(individual_net_buy_qty), foreign_net_buy_qty = VALUES(foreign_net_buy_qty), institution_net_buy_qty = VALUES(institution_net_buy_qty), individual_net_buy_amount = VALUES(individual_net_buy_amount), foreign_net_buy_amount = VALUES(foreign_net_buy_amount), institution_net_buy_amount = VALUES(institution_net_buy_amount), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code, trade_date, close_price, individual_net_buy_qty, foreign_net_buy_qty, institution_net_buy_qty, individual_net_buy_amount, foreign_net_buy_amount, institution_net_buy_amount, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_supply_demand_daily WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1
